features: Analytics — an Analytics section at the bottom of the Board shows page activity (total requests for PitchBoard, Collab Share, and Product Pages, broken down by game with a 30-day recent count) and cached storage size for the sheet
Delete Game — remove a game and all its data from the Edit Game dialog; deletes the game record, all pitch entries, any game sheets, and the cached JSON files in one step

Rename Game — changing a game's name in the Edit Game dialog updates all pitch records, renames any associated sheet tabs, and renames cached JSON files automatically; duplicate names are blocked and a confirmation is required before the rename is applied
Planned pitch status — record a publisher you intend to pitch in the future; shows an indigo Planned badge on publisher and game rows, with a matching filter pill in the status bar
CLEAR buttons on Compendium filters — remove all selections from a filter column in one click
Compendium filter renamed from Show All to Include Compendium
Profile dialog now follows the standard dialog protection pattern — unsaved changes shake the dialog instead of letting it close
Fixed: dates stored as Google Sheets serial integers now display correctly throughout the pitch log
Fixed: a newly added game is immediately searchable without a page refresh
Fixed: entering a contact as "Name email@example.com" now saves the name and email to separate fields
Remember me on sign-in — checking the box saves your email and password so the sign-in form pre-fills next time; uncheck it to stop saving credentials
Stopwatch — built into the session dialog to track how long a session runs; starts at 00:00 for new sessions and pre-loads the existing time when editing
Session number stored separately from event type — Event column holds the type (e.g. Playtest), People column holds the number, making it easy to filter the sheet by session type
Edit button on session rows — revealed on hover on desktop; appears when a session is expanded on touch devices
New sessions start with no people — testers are optional
Collab view improvements — game title on the session card, Help and Releases in the menu, app icon in the browser tab and on the home screen
DevBoard — new app for tracking playtest sessions, meetings, and ideas per game
Game cards with lazy-loaded session history, filterable by session type (Playtest, Meeting, Idea)
Session dialog — log date, type, location, testers, and observation/solution pairs in one form
Five-column sheet schema: Date, Event, People, Observations, Thoughts
Auto-resizing textareas — each field starts at one row and grows as you type
Keyboard navigation in the obs/sol grid — ⌘ / Ctrl + Arrow moves focus between fields
Trailing empty row styled faintly to distinguish it from filled rows
Dialog protection — shakes instead of closing when unsaved or edited data is present

Compendium — subscribe to the Cardboard Edison Compendium to bring publisher data into PitchBoard; expanded publisher cards show an INFO button with accepting status, categories, conventions, contact method, social links, and the publisher's logo
Features page — overview of PitchBoard capabilities for sharing with potential users
Board view — Kanban-style view of all games organised into Design, Pitch, Signed, and Published columns
Drag-and-drop game cards between columns — stage and status update automatically in the sheet
Date auto-fill — moving a game to Signed or Published fills the corresponding date if blank
Card expansion — click a card to see Started, Signed, and Published dates inline
View action — jumps to the game in the Games view with the card already expanded
Shelf / Unshelf — hide a game from the board without deleting it; shelved games appear in a collapsible section at the bottom
Dialog protection — clicking outside a dialog or pressing Escape now shakes the dialog instead of closing when unsaved data is present
Email button on publisher cards — opens your email client addressed to the publisher's contact; works even without a saved contact
Back button on game and sellsheet pages — returns you to the dashboard with the game card still expanded
Share button on the game page — copies the link or triggers the native share sheet on mobile
Collaborator link — share a game's pitchboard so anyone can add entries and edit pitches without an account
Auto-add contacts to People when a new pitch is added with an unknown contact name
Per-publisher + Pitch button inline on each publisher row
Combo boxes for Publisher and Contact on the collaborator card
Date Signed auto-fill — setting a pitch to Signed updates the game's Date Signed field automatically
Fixed: duplicate pitches on the same date now use sheet order to determine the latest entry
Fixed: Google API connection timeouts on Fetch no longer cause silent failures
Game Page tokens now appear without needing a Page URL field populated
PulseBoard now tracks and displays the logged-in user alongside each pulse entry
Enable Page / Edit Page button on each game card for creating a public game page
Sellsheet broken-image fallback on the game page
Video embed support on the game page
Components example section on the game page
